rounds.prompt: Match each eye part to its job.
rounds.explain: Iris controls light, lens focuses, retina receives the image.

rounds.prompt: The image formed on the retina is…
rounds.explain: It is inverted; the brain flips it upright for us.
The iris widens the pupil to let in more light in the dark.

rounds.prompt: Colours are detected by which cells?
rounds.explain: Cones detect colour in bright light; rods work in dim light.
The optic nerve exits there, so no image can form on the blind spot.
